summary: Completed comprehensive RBAC system testing. All 12 backend API endpoints and frontend UI components are working correctly. User Management and Role Management pages are fully functional with proper navigation, dialogs, and CRUD operations.
passed_tests: Backend: POST /api/admin/init - RBAC initialization (200)
Backend: GET /api/admin/permissions - List all 27 permissions across 7 categories (200)
Backend: GET /api/admin/permissions/my - Get current user permissions (200)
Backend: GET /api/admin/roles - List 4 system roles (200)
Backend: POST /api/admin/roles - Create custom role 'test_analyst' (200)
Backend: PUT /api/admin/roles/{id} - Update role permissions (200)
Backend: DELETE /api/admin/roles/{id} - Delete custom role (200)
Backend: GET /api/admin/users - List all users (200)
Backend: POST /api/admin/users - Create new user (200)
Backend: PUT /api/admin/users/{id} - Update user (200)
Backend: POST /api/admin/users/{id}/roles - Assign roles to user (200)
Backend: DELETE /api/admin/users/{id} - Delete user (200)
Frontend: User Management page loads at /users
Frontend: Role Management page loads at /roles
Frontend: Navigation sidebar shows User Management and Role Management under Administration section
Frontend: Create User dialog opens with all form fields (name, email, password, role assignment, active toggle)
Frontend: Create Role dialog opens with form fields (name, display name, description, permission categories)
Frontend: User actions menu opens with Edit User, Manage Roles, Remove Super Admin, Delete User options
Frontend: Role edit dialog opens with permission categories and checkboxes
Frontend: Users table displays correctly with 2 users
Frontend: Role cards display 4 system roles with permission counts
